name: ESPACIO The Jewel of Waikiki
positioning: Small luxury hotel on Kalakaua Avenue across from Waikiki Beach, where each suite is a full-floor residence and service is rooted in omotenashi
best_for: Families or groups wanting two- or three-bedroom suites across from Waikiki Beach
Travelers who want privacy, a butler and a house car with driver

facts.text: ESPACIO is on Kalakaua Avenue, directly across the street from Waikiki Beach.
Each suite is a full-floor residence, so guests never see another guest in their hallway.
Suites have a private elevator and entryway into the full-floor suite.
Bathrooms are spa-inspired, with TOTO Washlets, deep soaking tubs and glassed walk-in showers.
Suite interiors use Italian marble, with touches such as wooden stools in the shower that nod to Japanese style.
The top-floor Penthouse Diamond Suite has a balcony overlooking Waikiki Beach with a private Jacuzzi soaking tub and plush daybeds.
The fifth-floor Coral Suite is a three-bedroom accessible suite with a roll-in shower, lowered fixtures and TDD equipment.
Stays include butler services and a 24-hour concierge who curates bespoke itineraries and private experiences.
Stays include round-trip luxury airport transportation and a Mercedes house car with driver within central Honolulu.
ESPACIO Spa offers in-room massage and wellness experiences, with personalized treatments using rare botanicals and oceanic elements.
The spa has a spa bed by Gharieni that uses vibroacoustic technology.
At the restaurant Mugen, Executive Chef Colin Sato's menus are inspired by Hawaii and by French and Japanese culinary traditions.

highlights.text: The private rooftop has an infinity pool overlooking the Pacific; time there is by reservation so guests have it to themselves.
Every suite has an expansive furnished balcony with its own private Jacuzzi soaking tub.
Hospitality is rooted in omotenashi, the Japanese approach to selfless hospitality.
Stays include complimentary admission to the Bishop Museum and the Honolulu Museum of Art.
Signature Champagne and caviar experiences on the rooftop can be booked separately.

considerations.text: The spa is quite small for a luxury hotel, and in-suite treatments are recommended.
The hotel is on one of the busiest streets in Waikiki, and some street noise can reach the lower-floor suites.
Bedrooms at the back of the suites do not have beach or ocean views.
